newsitem.title: USA: Realco buys Mull Realty of Arizona.
newsitem.headline: Realco buys Mull Realty of Arizona.

text.p: Realco Inc said Monday it has a letter of intent to buy all outstanding stock of Mull Realty Co Inc, a Prudential real estate brokerage franchisee in Arizona, for cash and notes.
"Based on previous history, it appears that it would contribute somewhere between $0.07 and $0.10 per share (for the year)," company President James Arias said.
He added, however, that he was not making any definite earnings projections for the company.

The company reported earnings of $0.01 per share for the year ended September 30, after preferred stock dividends. Arias said documentation on the purchase should close January 31. He said the company will not take a charge for the purchase.
Mull Realty operates in northwest Phoenix and around Phoenix, Realco said.
Realco said it will explore the integration of its other activities into the Northwest Phoenix metropolitan Arizona market after the deal closes.
